aiVerification.summary: Draft identifies a comparable supplier/dimension Gauss check but the changed factor, conditions, metrics, and citations are not verification-ready.
issues: Changed factor is a filename, not the supplier and S-MG dimension comparison shown in the sheet.
Baseline and changed conditions are left unknown despite two explicit side-by-side conditions.
Gauss metrics are grouped under an overlong title and include Sample check as a measurement.
Stat evidence cites only the header row, not measured data rows.
Sheet2 hearing/xray context is not assessed for inclusion or separation.
requiredUserQuestions: Which side, if any, is baseline: Boutou or Ruijin?
Should Sheet2 hearing/xray be included in this same review case?
correctionPlan: Rename changed factor to Boutou vs Ruijin supplier with S-MG dimension difference; note C-MG dimension is same.
Use neutral condition labels if baseline/test is not confirmed.
Set outcomes to S-MG long, S-MG short, and C-MG Gauss measurements only.
Cite header rows plus all relevant Sheet1 data rows supporting each statistic.
Review Sheet2 and either add a supported hearing/xray outcome or exclude it with rationale.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Current citations prove headers only; final evidence needs condition header and data-row citations.
